name: CatalogService
description: Browse and order books from the catalog

skills.name: Data Query
skills.description:
Query data from the service. Available entities: 
 Books: Book details with author information 
 Currencies: Code list for currencies

See https://cap.cloud.sap/docs/cds/common#entity-currencies 
 Genres: Hierarchically organized Code List for Genres 
 ListOfBooks: Browse available books

skills.name: submitOrder
skills.description: Submit an order for a book

skills.name: getStock
skills.description: Get stock level for a specific book
examples: Get stock level for Wuthering Heights
